Statistical analysis was performed by using statistical software STATA 14.1, (Texas, USA). Continuous variables were expressed as mean (±standard deviation) or median (range) and categorical variables were expressed as percentages. Chi-square test/ Fisher’s exact test was used to assess the association of categorical variables. Student’s t-test/ Mann-Whitney U test was used to find out the significant difference of continuous variables between the two study groups.
